title: The Empty Throne
blurb: Twenty years on an empty throne, and her son thinks only a man can sit on it.

characters.name: Penelope
characters.description: Twenty years holding the throne alone. Furious.

characters.name: Telemachus
characters.description: Her son, back from Sparta with a desperate plan.

lines.text: If I kill them, their families will demand revenge. I'd be exiled,
lines.direction: Pacing. You've thought about this every night.

lines.text: and without me, the throne will be lost.
'Cause only a man can sit on it.
I've been sitting on that empty throne for 20 years.
lines.direction: Hand on your chest. Twenty years of anger.

lines.text: My knowledge, my years of experience, that's all nothing compared to the bristles on your chin.

source: The Odyssey (2026 film); OBS screen recording, transcribed with ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (diarized)
